associations.name: Date palm-fig oasis garden
associations.where: irrigated flats around the spring or well, deep moist soil in the oasis core
associations.source: Battesti 2005 Jardins au desert; Zaid 2002 FAO Date Palm Cultivation, traditional three-storey oasis

associations.name: Euphrates poplar-tamarisk riparian tugai
associations.where: river banks and wadi floors with shallow groundwater, seasonally flooded sand and silt
associations.source: Thevs et al. 2008 Tugai forests of the Tarim basin; Walter & Box 1983 Central Asian riparian woodland

associations.name: Reed-flatsedge spring margin
associations.where: waterlogged ground at the spring outflow and pool edges
associations.source: Zohary 1973 Geobotanical Foundations of the Middle East, Phragmites-Cyperus hydrophilous vegetation

associations.name: Camelthorn-saltcedar oasis fringe
associations.where: dry saline outer rim of the oasis where groundwater is deep, bare sand around
associations.source: Zohary 1973; Walter & Box 1983 Alhagi-Tamarix halophytic desert fringe

associations.name: Doum palm wadi
